limitations: Finding another mechanism involved in factual predictions does not disprove a contribution from embeddings.

statement.excerpt: GPT”s heavy use of a technique called embeddings makes it really good at substituting synonyms and more broadly related phrases, but the same tendency towards substitution often lead it astray.
statement.document_title: How come GPT can seem so brilliant one minute and so breathtakingly dumb the next?

our_interpretation: GPT means the GPT-3-era models discussed in the post.
The claim attributes both useful substitutions and recurrent errors to a shared embedding-driven substitution mechanism.
Often means a recurring, material source of errors; the post supplies no numerical frequency.

criteria.support_condition: Controlled interventions establish that embedding-based semantic substitution improves appropriate paraphrasing while also causing a recurring class of incorrect substitutions in the relevant GPT models.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Controlled studies directly testing the proposed pathway find that it does not cause the alleged errors, or that the supposed substitutions are not generated by that mechanism.
